citation.ref: Epoch AI, LLM inference price trends

provenance: Rates quoted verbatim from Epoch AI: the price of matching GPT-4's score on PhD-level science questions (GPQA) fell /40 per year; across benchmarks and thresholds the fall ranges /9 to /900 per year, median /50, steepening to a median of /200 per year since January 2024. points = relative price multiplier after x elapsed years at the GPQA bar (y = 40^-x), encoding the rate only; no absolute prices. Not peer-reviewed (research-org data insight); flagged in-app.
